definitions.explanation: An area designated for the protection of wildlife or natural features.

examples.japanese: {野生動物|やせいどうぶつ}{保護区|ほごく}を{訪|おとず}れた。
この{地域|ちいき}は{自然|しぜん}{保護区|ほごく}に{指定|してい}されている。
examples.english: This area is designated as a nature reserve.

examples.japanese: {保護区|ほごく}では{狩猟|しゅりょう}が{禁止|きんし}されている。
examples.english: Hunting is prohibited in the protected area.

notes:
{保護区|ほごく} refers to areas designated for environmental or wildlife protection.

WORD FORMATION:
{保護|ほご} (protection) + {区|く} (district/area)

TYPES OF PROTECTED AREAS:
- {自然|しぜん}{保護区|ほごく}: nature reserve
- {野生動物|やせいどうぶつ}{保護区|ほごく}: wildlife reserve
- {鳥獣|ちょうじゅう}{保護区|ほごく}: wildlife sanctuary
- {海洋|かいよう}{保護区|ほごく}: marine protected area

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {保護区|ほごく}に{指定|してい}する: to designate as a protected area
- {保護区|ほごく}に{入|はい}る: to enter a protected area

RELATED:
- {国立|こくりつ}{公園|こうえん}: national park
- {天然|てんねん}{記念|きねん}{物|ぶつ}: natural monument
